scores.evidence: Phase 2 "Depends on: V1 and V2"; Phase 3 "Depends on: V2 and V3"; Phase 4 "Depends on: V4"
scores.rationale: Each phase names its predecessor and a validation gate that must pass before the dependent phase starts, going from skeleton to trust to scale to delivery to onboarding to decommission.

scores.evidence: A real commit to one low-risk internal service is built, unit-tested, pushed to the registry by digest, written to the env repo, synced to a production canary by Argo
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real production end-to-end slice with rollback and an exit check, and it comes before any feature work.

scores.evidence: Trust boundary... Default: OIDC federation... Flip condition: V2 fails, or a provider lacks OIDC (then use a vault with ≤1 h leases)
scores.rationale: The irreversible decisions are listed with reversibility, a default, an assumption, a validation and a flip condition, and the missing inputs are stated.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Trust and contracts (widest rework first); Phase 4 Waves of 4 → 10 → 15 → 20 services, lowest-criticality first
scores.rationale: Widest-impact items (credential model, contract) come first, and onboarding goes from the smallest exposure to the largest.

scores.evidence: 0: Scoped deploy role, branch protection on the env repo | 1: OIDC, signing, admission policy | 2: Ephemeral runners, network egress allow-list
scores.rationale: Every phase, starting with Phase 0, has concrete security work.

scores.evidence: OpenTelemetry traces carry the commit SHA end to end, plus pipeline logs and an alert on deploy failure or sync drift.
scores.rationale: Observability is in Phase 0 and has concrete items in each later phase.

scores.evidence: Pipeline-as-code, pinned action SHAs | Provenance attestations, digest-only deploys | Hermetic builds, locked base images
scores.rationale: Each phase has concrete reproducibility measures, from Phase 0 pinning to archived configs in Phase 5.

scores.evidence: Git-revert rollback, legacy pipeline as fallback | Admission audit mode before enforce | Autoscale floor, break-glass drill
scores.rationale: Failure handling and per-phase rollback appear in every phase, starting with Phase 0.

scores.evidence: N/A: there is no AI component.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.
